    Nat.ModEq.add (h19.pow 19) (h99.pow 99)

      _ ≡ 1 ^ 9 * 9 [MOD 10] := Nat.ModEq.mul (h9sq.pow 9) (by rfl)
      _ = 9 := by norm_num
